statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete. Representative non-home routes were directly tested and consistently returned Cloudflare 403 verification pages; this is recorded as a user-facing issue rather than an unexecuted check.

page.framework: WordPress with Elementor, Bootstrap/jQuery, and SuperPWA
page.notes: Public Hindi-first adult story listing. Homepage loads, while all sampled destination templates are challenged with HTTP 403.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshot plus computed-style/CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page remains beige/light, reports color-scheme normal, and has no dark preference media rule.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion probe and rendered CSS inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The media query matches, CSS includes reduced-motion handling, and getAnimations() reports no active animations.

checkOutcomes.method: High-contrast screenshot, CSS inspection, and Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: No prefers-contrast/forced-colors CSS is present; ordinary newsletter text already fails at 3.65:1.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/DOM inspection across homepage and destination navigation
checkOutcomes.evidence: No View Transition declarations are shipped; destination changes are abrupt verification documents.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered stylesheet feature probe and long-task trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded CSS includes animation-timeline usage; trace blocking remains modest at 55ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered CSS feature probe and repeated mobile-menu exercise
checkOutcomes.evidence: CSS includes scroll-snap; the mobile off-canvas menu can be repeatedly toggled without DOM growth.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile/desktop screenshot and CSS feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Chrome is fixed and duplicated; no scroll-state container-query behavior was found to orient users through the long listing.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/CSS inventory of overlays, tooltips, and menus
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-attached popover requiring anchor positioning was found; the navigation is an off-canvas panel.
checkOutcomes.reason: No applicable anchored overlay is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Cross-route walkthrough and CSS transition inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No route transition or post-navigation highlight guides attention; successful navigation is replaced by a verification screen.

checkOutcomes.method: First-load desktop/mobile screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: The only full-viewport interruption is a concise age-verification gate appropriate to adult content; no unrelated newsletter/advertising popup appears above it.

checkOutcomes.method: First-load screenshot and DOM semantic inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: A visible modal gate is not represented by dialog/popover/details in the inspectable page DOM.

checkOutcomes.method: Full-page visual review plus third-party/network inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Multiple nav bands, ads, subscription UI, and a network promo compete with the primary story list.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 360x800 and 1440x900
checkOutcomes.evidence: Horizontal overflow is 300px at both widths.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature inspection and paired viewport screenshots
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container rules are loaded for reusable cards/sidebar modules.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus/target probe and Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unnamed/small controls, invisible focus states, and disabled zoom fail modality parity.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshot, title/H1 and navigation review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The title, Antarvasna H1, latest-stories heading, category navigation, and story links make the reading purpose clear.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct navigation to article, category, archive, and submission paths
checkOutcomes.evidence: All four representative destination paths return 403 verification pages.

checkOutcomes.method: Timed blocked-route and missing-route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The state says verification succeeded but never recovers and exposes no retry/home/support action.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus DevTools trace summary
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse LCP is 7.1s and FCP 4.3s; trace LCP is 3.35s.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout-shift observers plus image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Observed CLS reaches 0.38 mobile/0.25 desktop and all images lack intrinsic dimensions.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace and layout long-task observer
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace TBT is 55ms with two long tasks; Lighthouse TBT is 30ms.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary, live script attributes, and Lighthouse diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has many parser-blocking styles, 64 requests, poor cache/render-blocking insights, and slow LCP.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse coverage diagnostics and HAR resource counts
checkOutcomes.evidence: Estimated unused code is 115KiB CSS plus 73KiB JS; 30 scripts and 13 stylesheets load.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audits and DOM inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unnamed controls/links, untitled frames, unlabeled select, and no main landmark are reported.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse computed contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Newsletter text and consent labels measure 3.65:1 instead of 4.5:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Heading/landmark and focus-style probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: There are duplicate H1s, no main landmark, and several focusable duplicate controls have no visible outline.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile visual review and zoom policy inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long Hindi text is rendered very small on mobile and user scaling is disabled, reducing reading comfort.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile layout, viewport meta, Lighthouse target-size audit, and media inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: user-scalable=no, target-size failures, and 300px overflow prevent robust zoom/reflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse Runtime/console audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The errors-in-console audit passes with no recorded console errors.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM/image probe and Lighthouse best-practices diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/UTF-8 are valid, but images lack dimensions and deprecated/legacy/unminified assets are flagged.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse deprecation, Issues, BFCache, and third-party diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: BFCache passes, but three deprecations and DevTools inspector issues remain.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM probe and Lighthouse SEO audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: A descriptive title and meta description are present; Lighthouse passes both.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM links/viewport probe, robots fetch, Lighthouse SEO/accessibility, route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Real links and robots exist, but 26 links have no discernible text, zoom is disabled, and public destinations are challenged.

checkOutcomes.method: Status/canonical/robots/sitemap probes across representative routes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Homepage canonical/index signals pass, but sampled public routes return 403 noindex challenge pages and sitemap fetching is challenged.

checkOutcomes.method: JSON-LD and Open Graph DOM inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: CollectionPage/Breadcrumb/WebSite JSON-LD plus title, description, URL, and image Open Graph tags describe the homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers, cookies, HAR, and secret scan
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS are present and no secrets were found, but CSP/Referrer-Policy are missing and naslvq is not Secure.

checkOutcomes.method: Tracker enumeration, HAR third-party summary, and Lighthouse cookie audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: 13 third-party origins and 19 third-party requests start on load; six third-party cookies are reported by Lighthouse.

checkOutcomes.method: Permissions-Policy/header and load-state inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Camera, microphone, geolocation, USB, and MIDI are denied by policy; no permission prompt fires on load. No first-party auth surface was reachable in the sampled content flow.

checkOutcomes.method: Security-header and cookie inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS/X-Frame-Options/nosniff/Permissions-Policy are present, but CSP and Referrer-Policy are absent and SameSite=None cookies remain.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw HTML/rendered DOM diff and crawler screenshot pair
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML is 200, not a JS shell, contains title/H1/description, and covers 78% of rendered content words.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route and runtime dependency walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Four ordinary destinations fail behind a persistent 403 verification state.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest fetch, service-worker registration, and HAR inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: A service worker controls the page, but the linked manifest returns 403 HTML and cannot parse.

checkOutcomes.method: Missing route and challenge failure walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The sampled missing route is replaced by an indefinite challenge with no useful retry or 404 recovery.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM lang/dir, content-language, JSON-LD, and CSS logical-property inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: lang and JSON-LD say en-US although content is Hindi-first; logical CSS properties are present.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered date-format inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Story dates are emitted as fixed YYYY-MM-DD strings despite a Hindi-first audience and no locale-aware presentation is evident.

checkOutcomes.method: Content and data-field inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited reading/listing experience contains publication dates but no times, events, recurrence, deadlines, or cross-zone coordination.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive flow exists in the representative scope.

checkOutcomes.method: First-load gate, navigation, advertising, consent, and policy-link visual/DOM review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The age gate states its purpose plainly; newsletter consent is unchecked/required and privacy/report-content links are present. No forced continuity was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Form semantics and native validation-attribute inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The newsletter email and consent fields are explicitly labelled and required, allowing native post-interaction validation rather than premature error states.

checkOutcomes.method: Form field label/autocomplete inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: The newsletter email has no autocomplete token and duplicated search forms add friction.

checkOutcomes.method: Submission/account route walkthrough and on-load third-party review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The story submission/account journey is blocked by 403, so commitments, confirmation, cancellation, and recovery cannot be inspected or completed.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse byte/image diagnostics, HAR summary, and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: A text listing reaches 5,560KiB in Lighthouse; image delivery savings and missing dimensions are flagged.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR resource counts, trace, and Lighthouse unused-code diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: 30 scripts, 13 stylesheets, 188KiB estimated unused code, and on-load ad/stat requests indicate avoidable work.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR third-party/media budget and Lighthouse total-byte audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: 19 third-party requests and multi-megabyte Lighthouse weight are disproportionate to the text-first core task.

checkOutcomes.method: Site-purpose and source/DOM capability inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public editorial reading site exposes no transactional agent capability requiring WebMCP; server-rendered links/content remain machine-readable.
checkOutcomes.reason: Emerging agent tools are not necessary for this editorial surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Site-purpose and built-in AI API inventory
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, or inference task is part of the current user journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no user-facing inference task to move on device.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap summaries around 10 open/close mobile-menu cycles plus DOM/heap metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: After repeated menu interaction, DOM count changes by one; heap snapshot size changes from 20.17MB to 20.67MB (about 2.5%) with no unbounded pattern in this bounded run.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary totals and page-purpose comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: The loaded page retains about 20.2MB in the baseline heap, proportionate to this WordPress page despite its network inefficiency.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap constructor summaries and DOM count comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: No Detached* constructor appears among retained top constructors, and repeated menu use adds only one live DOM node.

principleOutcomes.reason: This editorial site has no agent-facing action or inference task; its server-rendered content remains machine-readable.

paths.description: Homepage/listing template and entry journey; tested desktop/mobile, preferences, accessibility, performance, network, security, crawlability, and memory.
Representative story/detail template selected from the first listing item; direct navigation attempted to test reading and route continuity.
Representative category/listing template selected from primary category navigation.
Primary contribution form journey linked as “submit story”.
Archive/discovery template linked from primary navigation.
Synthetic missing route used to inspect HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: The manual theme control does not follow the system dark preference.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the screenshot remains the same beige light palette; the probe reports body background rgb(227,219,190), colorScheme normal, and no prefers-color-scheme CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and apply system-driven theme tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(); retain the manual override.

findings.summary: High-contrast preferences are not handled and ordinary text contrast already fails.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors rules. Lighthouse reports 3.65:1 text and consent-label contrast where 4.5:1 is required.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations and raise text/label contrast to WCAG minimums without suppressing system colors.

findings.summary: Route and navigation changes have no View Transition treatment or attention cue.
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS has no view-transition declarations and representative cross-document routes switch to an abrupt Cloudflare verification page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback and preserve directional context between listings and articles.

findings.summary: The age-verification overlay is not represented by a native dialog in the page DOM.
findings.evidence: Load screenshots show a full-viewport modal gate, while the DOM probe reports zero dialog, popover, or details elements and the gate cannot be found through ordinary page DOM inspection.
findings.suggestedFix: Integrate age verification as an accessible modal dialog with a programmatic name, focus trapping, restored focus, and an explicit adult-confirmation action.

findings.summary: Advertising and duplicated navigation compete with the reading experience.
findings.evidence: The full-page screenshot shows multiple navigation bands, sidebar/inline ads, subscription chrome, and a network promotion block around the story list; 19 third-party requests support that non-content footprint.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate navigation, reserve a limited number of clearly labelled ad slots, and defer nonessential promotional chrome until after primary content.

findings.summary: The layout overflows horizontally at both mobile and desktop widths.
findings.evidence: The layout primitive reports 660px content at a 360px viewport and 1740px at 1440px, both exactly 300px too wide. The viewport also disables user scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed 300px overflow source, constrain embeds with max-inline-size:100%, use intrinsic grids, and change the viewport to width=device-width, initial-scale=1 without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: Reusable listing and sidebar components rely on global layout rather than container responsiveness.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules despite cards and promotional/sidebar components being reused at materially different widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable modules containment and adapt their layout/typography with size container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard, touch, and zoom users receive an inferior interaction model.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports unnamed buttons/links, insufficient target size, and user-scalable=no. The focus probe finds several controls with no visible outline and zero-sized duplicate navigation controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible :focus-visible styling, accessible names, at least 44px touch targets, remove hidden controls from tab order, and allow pinch zoom.

findings.summary: Cloudflare blocks every sampled destination beyond the homepage.
findings.evidence: The article, category, archive, and submit-story routes each returned HTTP 403 and remained on “Performing security verification”, preventing reading, browsing, and submission flows.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust Cloudflare bot/challenge rules so normal direct navigation and non-abusive browsers can reach public routes; verify challenge clearance across all templates.

findings.summary: The verification/failure state offers no useful recovery path.
findings.evidence: After 4–6 seconds, blocked routes still claim verification succeeded while returning 403, with no retry, back-to-home, or support action. The sampled missing URL is intercepted by the same state instead of a useful 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a bounded verification timeout, Retry and Home actions, a support reference, and a real branded 404/recovery page once routing is reached.

findings.summary: The homepage misses the good loading-performance range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 4.3s, LCP 7.1s, Speed Index 5.5s, and Time to Interactive 10.0s (performance score 0.63). The trace independently measured LCP 3.35s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP element, reduce render-blocking CSS, defer noncritical scripts/ads, and retest under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: Observed page states shift substantially and images do not reserve dimensions.
findings.evidence: The layout observer recorded CLS 0.38 mobile and 0.25 desktop during the capture window. The image audit found all three img elements lacked width and height; Lighthouse also flags unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for images, ads, banners, and fonts using width/height or aspect-ratio and metrically compatible font fallbacks.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS/JavaScript and legacy plugin code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 115KiB unused CSS and 73KiB unused JS; 90–99% of several Elementor/theme stylesheets are unused. The page loads 30 scripts and 13 stylesheets in the HAR.
findings.suggestedFix: Unload page-builder/plugin assets where unused, split template bundles, remove jQuery migrate where safe, and ship only critical CSS for the listing template.

findings.summary: Key controls, links, frames, and structure are not exposed accessibly.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility is 0.70 and fails button-name, link-name, frame-title, select-name, and landmark-one-main. The DOM probe finds 26 links without discernible text and no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every control/link, title third-party frames, label selects, add one main landmark, and hide inactive duplicate navigation from assistive technology.

findings.summary: Newsletter and consent text fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse calculates a 3.65:1 ratio for newsletter explanatory text and consent labels against #f4edd2, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken secondary text colors and test every theme state against WCAG AA contrast.

findings.summary: Document assets and platform usage show avoidable hygiene problems.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags unsized images, three deprecated API warnings, legacy JavaScript, inspector issues, and unminified CSS/JS; the image primitive confirms missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions, replace deprecated calls/libraries, resolve DevTools Issues, and serve production-minified bundles.

findings.summary: Good homepage metadata is undermined by unnamed links, disabled zoom, and blocked destination pages.
findings.evidence: The homepage is server-rendered at 78% raw/rendered word coverage and passes Lighthouse SEO, but 26 links lack discernible text, user-scalable=no is present, and sampled public destinations return 403/noindex challenge pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep real hrefs but add descriptive accessible text, permit zoom, and exempt public content routes and sitemap endpoints from inappropriate challenge rules.

findings.summary: Security headers and one first-party cookie are incomplete.
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff, X-Frame-Options, and Permissions-Policy are present, but CSP and Referrer-Policy are absent. Cookie naslvq is Secure=false, HttpOnly=false, SameSite=None, and lasts 365 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and Referrer-Policy; mark cookies Secure with an appropriate SameSite mode and minimise lifetime/scope.

findings.summary: Third-party code and data sharing begin before meaningful consent.
findings.evidence: The tracker probe finds 13 third-party origins. HAR records 19 third-party requests and 182,465 transferred bytes, including advertising, statistics, and age-verification services; Lighthouse reports six third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory each vendor, remove nonessential origins, gate optional advertising/analytics behind informed consent, sandbox embeds, and document retention/purpose.

findings.summary: The advertised PWA manifest is broken.
findings.evidence: A service worker controls the homepage, but fetching superpwa-manifest-nginx.json returns 403/HTML and JSON parsing fails. The HAR records the manifest failure twice.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid manifest with 200 JSON, verify icons/start_url, and provide a tested offline fallback from the service worker.

findings.summary: The document language does not describe the Hindi-first content.
findings.evidence: html lang is en-US while the title, navigation, listings, form text, and body content are predominantly Hindi. JSON-LD also declares en-US.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the primary document language to hi (or hi-IN), mark genuine English runs with lang=en, and keep direction/logical properties translation-safe.

findings.summary: Forms omit autofill assistance and the main submission route is blocked.
findings.evidence: The newsletter email field has an empty autocomplete value; search controls are duplicated. The story-submission route returns 403 before users can inspect or complete its form.
findings.suggestedFix: Add correct autocomplete tokens and accessible labels, eliminate inactive duplicate controls, and restore reliable access to the submission/account flow.

findings.summary: Third-party, CSS, script, and media costs are disproportionate to a text listing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports a 5,560KiB total payload; HAR sees 64 requests with 30 scripts, 13 stylesheets, and 19 third-party requests. Unused CSS/JS alone accounts for about 188KiB potential savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a template weight/request budget, remove or lazy-load ads/media, unload unused plugin assets, and cache/defer noncritical third-party work.

taskList.title: Stop Cloudflare from blocking public article, category, archive, and submission routes; add bounded recovery states
Fix horizontal overflow, enable zoom, and repair focus/target accessibility
Reduce LCP and page weight by removing render-blocking and unused plugin/third-party assets
Deploy CSP/Referrer-Policy, secure cookie attributes, and a consent-gated third-party inventory
Reserve dimensions for dynamic content and eliminate layout shifts
Make the age gate and all controls semantically accessible
Honor system theme/contrast preferences and correct Hindi language metadata
Serve a valid manifest/offline fallback and add autofill assistance
Simplify navigation and advertising chrome; add container-aware component layouts
Add reduced-motion-safe cross-document transitions after route reliability is restored
